description: Use this to see how far a report has got and what has been found so far, or to read a ready report: its date, the main point, any questions to ask, what was found, the next steps, the companies worth a look next and its link. LightRay writes each report: the main point, questions, findings and next steps are LightRay's. Give the report_id that check_company or list_reports returned, or the report's link. Reading a report uses none of the reader's reports.

report_id.description: The report_id that check_company or list_reports returned, or the report's link.

name: get_report
title: Read a report
